summary: Backend: 15/16 pytest tests passed. All auth, games, packages, generate (quick + AI + 402 path), picks history work. Stripe checkout session creation works. Frontend: Auth/register/login, navigation, Quick Pick spin (drum + balls), Profile (email/VIP badge/logout) all work. Found UI z-index bug where bottom-nav overlaps in-page CTAs (Generate Again button in result modal, and Checkout button on VIP page) so e2e flows blocked. AI Predict flow on frontend did not produce result modal within 60s despite backend AI generation working in <25s in pytest.

critical.issue: Returns 500 with 'No such checkout.session: cs_test_...' error from Stripe. The session is created successfully by POST /api/payments/checkout (returns valid https://checkout.stripe.com URL) but immediate status retrieval fails. Likely STRIPE_API_KEY mismatch between create and status flows in emergentintegrations, or the session belongs to a different Stripe account than the one used for status lookups.

ui_bugs.issue: The fixed bottom-nav with z-50 overlaps the result-modal's 'Generate Again' button (and possibly other CTAs at bottom of page). Pointer events from nav intercept clicks, blocking users from clicking 'Generate Again'. Modal also lacks comfortable bottom padding to avoid this.

The 'checkout-stripe-button' is positioned near the bottom of the page and gets intercepted by bottom-nav (nav-history). Clicking it navigates to /history instead of starting Stripe checkout. Need to add bottom safe area padding (e.g. pb-24) on VIP page.

select-zodiac appears to be a native HTML <select> with default option '— pick your sign —' but is not visually styled or accessible in some viewports (Playwright reported 'Element is not visible' when expanding options). Inconsistent with rest of dark casino UI. Consider using shadcn Select component.

Button is NOT disabled even when birthday/zodiac/lucky inputs are empty, contradicting the requirement 'AI tab requires inputs (birthday/zodiac/lucky)'. Clicking it with empty zodiac did not show validation toast nor result modal within 60s in our test.

integration_issues.issue: After filling birthday + lucky numbers (zodiac left empty due to native select issue) and clicking predict-ai-button, the result-modal never appeared within 60s. Backend AI generation works (pytest test_generate_ai_consumes_credit passes in <30s). Likely cause: missing zodiac value blocked client-side, or error response was not surfaced as a toast.

issues: Content reaches the bottom of the viewport and gets covered by fixed bottom-nav. Add pb-20 or pb-24 to page wrappers (or matching safe-area).

action_items: Investigate Stripe 'No such checkout.session' on GET /api/payments/status/{session_id} - verify same STRIPE_API_KEY used for both create and retrieve, and that emergentintegrations isn't switching accounts.

Fix bottom-nav z-index overlap: add bottom padding (pb-20/pb-24) to Generate, VIP page wrappers OR lower z-index of nav OR raise z-index of modal and ensure modal body has safe-area margin so 'Generate Again' is clickable.

Disable [data-testid=predict-ai-button] when birthday/zodiac/lucky_numbers are not all filled, OR show explicit validation toast on click. Also show an error toast if /api/generate returns non-200 in AI mode.
Replace native <select> in select-zodiac with shadcn Select for consistent casino-themed UI and to allow Playwright to expand options reliably.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py reads JWT_SECRET/JWT_ALGORITHM/JWT_EXPIRE_MINUTES/EMERGENT_LLM_KEY/STRIPE_API_KEY via os.environ[...] at import time - will hard-fail on startup if any is missing (acceptable, but document required env keys).
Allow-origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True is technically invalid per CORS spec - browsers will reject credentialed requests. Tighten allow_origins to actual frontend URL.
ai_lucky_pick imports emergentintegrations inside the function - fine for cold-start savings but moves errors to first request. Consider lazy module-level import.

_grant_package writes credits idempotently via credits_granted flag - good. But the user_update happens BEFORE the txn flag is set; if user_update succeeds and txn update fails the credit may be granted twice on retry. Wrap in a guard: re-fetch txn with {credits_granted: False} as a filter for the update or use a transactional approach.
GET /api/payments/status grants credits if paid - but webhook also grants. The credits_granted flag protects against double-grant which is correct.

success_rate.frontend: 70% (auth, nav, quick pick, profile/logout work; AI predict & Stripe checkout blocked by UI/integration issues)

test_credentials: Each run creates fresh user tester+{timestamp}@lottoluxe.com / lucky123
seed_data_creation: None - tests register fresh users each run
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite is at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. Re-run with: pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. After main agent fixes the bottom-nav overlap and AI button validation, re-run frontend playwright. The Stripe status 500 may require emergentintegrations support if env keys look right.
rca of the issue:
1) Stripe 500: Stripe error 'No such checkout.session' immediately after creation suggests either (a) live vs test mode mismatch on STRIPE_API_KEY in create vs status calls, or (b) emergentintegrations using different credentials between StripeCheckout instances. Two separate StripeCheckout objects are instantiated (one for create, one for status) - both use same env var so should be identical. Worth printing the api_key prefix in each call to confirm.
2) Bottom-nav overlap: Generate/VIP pages do not reserve bottom padding for the fixed bottom-nav. Mobile viewport (414x850) is short so bottom CTAs land directly under the nav.
3) AI Predict modal not appearing: likely either client-side validation rejects empty zodiac silently, or AI API call errors and the error toast/spinner is not visible. Backend itself responds correctly (pytest passes).
